en: In fact, [[people]] [[would have understood]] [[each other]] better if humans had developed this ability sooner.
me: better if humans had developed this ability sooner.
easy: People would have understood each other
if humans had developed this ability sooner
인간이 이 능력을 더 일찍 발달시켰더라면(develop(발달시키다)).
요약: 마음을 읽는 능력이 일찍 생겼다면 서로를 더 잘 이해했을 것이다.
notes: would have p.p. ↔ if + had p.p. (과거 반대). developed ✕ → had developed ○

en: Scientists devoted years to developing weapons that they hoped would end the war quickly, but [[few]] [[were]] [[prepared]] to accept the consequences.
me: Scientists devoted years to developing weapons that they hoped would end the war quickly, but
easy: 준비가 된 사람은 거의 없었다(be prepared(준비되다)).
Scientists devoted years to developing weapons that they hoped would end the war quickly
과학자들은 전쟁을 빨리 끝내길(end(끝내다)) 바란 무기를 개발하는(develop(개발하다)) 데 몇 년을 바쳤다(devote(바치다)).
요약: 무기 개발엔 몇 년을 쏟았지만, 그 결과를 받아들일 준비가 된 사람은 드물었다.
notes: be prepared to + 동사원형 = ~할 준비가 되어 있다. 이 to는 to부정사의 to. to accepting ✕ → to accept ○
devote A to -ing (A를 ~하는 데 바치다)는 to가 전치사라 -ing를 쓴다. 두 to를 구별하자.

en: [[Their marketing teams]] often [[act]] as if the competition didn't exist at all.
me: as if the competition didn't exist at all.
easy: as if the competition didn't exist at all
마치 경쟁이 전혀 존재하지(exist(존재하다)) 않는 것처럼.
요약: 마케팅 팀은 경쟁자가 없는 듯 행동한다.
notes: as if + 과거형: 사실과 다른 상상. doesn't ✕ → didn't ○

en: [[This]] [[is]] [[a lesson]] especially important for people who struggle with the fear of failure.
me: a lesson especially important for people who struggle with the fear of failure.
easy: who struggle with the fear of failure
요약: 실패가 두려운 사람에게 특히 중요한 교훈이다.
notes: 사람 선행사 + who (which ✕), 사물이면 which/that. people who struggle ○

en: If he decides to learn a third language next year, [[he]] [[will almost certainly succeed]] quickly.
me: If he decides to learn a third language next year,
easy: If he decides to learn a third language next year
그가 내년에 세 번째 언어를 배우기로 결심한다면(decide(결심하다)).
요약: 내년에 세 번째 언어를 배우면 빠르게 성공할 것이 거의 확실하다.
notes: if + 현재시제(decides) → 주절 will: 실제 가능성. would ✕ → will ○

en: [[Many teachers]] [[believe]] [[that students would have performed even better if they had received more personalized guidance earlier in their education]].
me: that students would have performed even better if they had received more personalized guidance earlier in their education.
easy: Teachers believe that students would have performed better
교사들은 학생들이 더 잘 해냈을 것이라고 믿는다(believe(믿다), perform(해내다)).
if they had received more personalized guidance earlier
학생들이 더 개인에게 맞는 지도를 일찍 받았더라면(receive(받다)).
요약: 일찍 맞춤 지도를 받았다면 학생들이 훨씬 더 잘했을 것이라고 교사들은 믿는다.
notes: would have p.p. ↔ if + had p.p. (과거 반대). received ✕ → had received ○
